capture_method: OneROM live ROM substitution; checksum-protected RBCP; original backup restored and readback verified
repeatability: One physical capture; two repetitions per condition. Pilot phase coverage is limited.

observation_profile.variant: bit0 BLTPRI; bit1 CPU launch; bit2 marker after size; bit3 no blit
observation_profile.observer: FFC A00 (FFCA00); four alternating INTREQR/DMACONR pairs, no stores between reads

fields.20..34: four INTREQR/DMACONR pairs; status and saved PC are raw samples

observation_profile.units: raw register values; beam brackets only; no inferred cycle offsets or trace alignment
observation_profile.copper: line66 h60 WAIT; marker/size adjacent moves in either order; no BFD completion marker
observation_profile.limits: CPU sequence starts after its gate; Copper sequence starts at fixed WAIT. Do not equate their gates to transfer timestamps.
